blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced chart understanding and reasoning, yet their performance remains highly uneven across chart types. While modern MLLMs perform well on common charts, their accuracy drops sharply on long-tail charts with diverse visual structures and reasoning requirements. Tool-augmented agents can improve complex chart reasoning by introducing specialized visual capabilities, but manually engineering strategies and tools for the heterogeneous and evolving long tail is difficult to scale. We introduce \textbf{ChartEvo}, a recursive self-improvement framework that enables chart agents to adapt to underperforming chart types through experience-driven harness-level self-improvement. ChartEvo jointly evolves reusable chart-specific Skills and executable Tools, while learning reusable local tool-call chains to compose evolved capabilities and control the inference overhead of tool-augmented reasoning. On long-tail charts from ChartBench and ChartX, ChartEvo improves accuracy over its base MLLM, Qwen3.7-Plus, by \textbf{45.6\%} and \textbf{32.5\%}, respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of recursive self-improvement for long-tail chart adaptation.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)在图的理解和推理方面有很大的进步,但其性能在图型之间仍然很不平衡. 虽然现代的MLLMs在常见图表上表现良好,但其精度却在具有多种视觉结构和推理要求的长尾图上急剧下降. 工具增强剂可以通过引入专门的视觉能力来改进复杂的图表推理,但手动工程策略和工具对于千差万别和不断演变的长尾巴来说是难以衡量的. 我们引入\textbf{ChartEvo},一个递归自我改进框架,通过经验驱动的牵引式自改进,使图表代理能够适应表现不佳的图表类型. 图表 Evo联合进化了可重复使用的图表特定技能和可执行工具,同时学习可重复使用的本地工具调用链,以编译进化的能力,控制工具增强推理的推论间接费用. 在图奔驰和图X的长尾图上,图埃沃分别通过\textbf{45.6\%}和\textbf{32.5\%},提高了其基础MLLM,Quen3.7-Plus的精度,证明了对长尾图修改的递归自我改进的有效性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially improved chart understanding and reasoning, yielding strong overall performance on established chart question answering (CQA) benchmarks chartqa ; chartbench . Tool-augmented approaches such as ChartAgent chartagent further extend chart reasoning by incorporating specialized visual tools for complex visual and numerical tasks. However, strong aggregate performance can obscure substantial performance disparities across chart types chartqapro ; chartmind . On the numerical question answering (NQA) task in ChartBench, Qwen3.7-Plus achieves an average accuracy of 80.0% across 26 chart types. Among them, 17 types exceed 90% accuracy, with an average of 96.9%, whereas the remaining nine average only 48.0%. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , this disparity reveals a highly uneven performance distribution: while many chart types are handled reliably, the remaining underperforming types form a heterogeneous tail with distinct visual structures and reasoning requirements. We refer to these persistently underperforming chart types as long-tail charts . This uneven performance distribution suggests that further progress in CQA increasingly depends on an agent’s ability to adapt to these diverse, chart-specific capability gaps.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的近期进展大大提高了图表的理解和推理,在既定图表问题回答(CQA)基准图表qa(chartbench )上产生了强大的总体性能. Chart Agent chartagent等工具辅助方法通过为复杂的视觉和数字任务纳入专门的视觉工具,进一步扩大图表推理. 然而,强劲的总体业绩可以掩盖图表类型(图qapro)之间的巨大业绩差异。 在图本奇的数值问题回答(NQA)任务上,Quen3.7-Plus在26个图表类型中的平均精度达到了80.0%. 其中,17种超过90%的准确度,平均96.9%,其余9种平均只有48.0%。 如图1所示,这种差异表明,业绩分布极不均匀:虽然许多图表类型得到可靠处理,但其余表现不佳的类型则构成一种不同的尾巴,具有不同的视觉结构和推理要求。 我们把这些长期表现不佳的图表称为长尾图。 这种不均衡的绩效分布表明,在质量评估方面的进一步进展越来越取决于一个代理人适应这些多样化的、针对图表的能力差距的能力。

blocks.en: Addressing this heterogeneous long tail requires capable MLLMs to continually acquire new capabilities for chart types they have not yet mastered. One possible route is to further train the model, encoding the missing capabilities into its parameters. However, repeatedly adapting model parameters to address localized capability gaps across diverse chart structures and reasoning patterns is neither naturally modular nor readily extensible. Tool-augmented chart agents provide a more modular alternative by introducing specialized visual operations that complement the MLLM. Yet, existing approaches largely rely on manually predefined tools and usage strategies, leaving the agent’s capability boundary constrained by human engineering. As unresolved failures span diverse chart structures and reasoning requirements, manually extending the agent for each distinct failure mode becomes difficult to scale. This motivates shifting long-tail adaptation from manual capability engineering toward autonomous capability acquisition .
blocks.zh: 解决这种千差万别的长尾巴需要有能力的MLLMs不断获得它们尚未掌握的图型的新能力. 一种可能的路线是进一步训练模型,将缺失的能力编码到它的参数中. 然而,反复调整模型参数以解决不同图表结构和推理模式的局部能力差距,既不是自然模块化的,也不是随时可以推广的。 工具增强图剂通过引入辅助MLLM的专用视觉操作,提供了更模块化的替代方案. 然而,现有办法主要依靠人工预先界定的工具和使用战略,使代理人的能力界限受到人类工程的制约。 由于未解决的故障跨越了不同的图表结构和推理要求,因此很难为每个不同的故障模式手动扩展代理. 这促使长尾适应从人工能力工程转向自主能力获取。

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce ChartEvo , a recursively self-improving chart agent that autonomously evolves its harness to acquire and organize capabilities for long-tail chart reasoning. An illustrative overview of ChartEvo and its contrast with direct MLLM and fixed-tool reasoning is shown in Fig. 2 . ChartEvo progressively accumulates reusable capabilities in its external harness. Specifically, it jointly evolves chart-specific Skills that capture reusable reasoning knowledge and executable Tools that expand the agent’s visual and numerical capabilities. Skills thus encode how to reason, while Tools extend what the agent can execute, enabling acquired capabilities to be retained and effectively applied across related chart instances.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了ChartEvo, 这是一种递归性的自我改进图剂, 它自动地发展了它的能力,以获取和组织长尾图推理的能力。 图埃沃及其与直接的MLLM和固定工具推理的对比的示例性概述见Fig. 2. ChartEvo逐步积累其外部利用的可再利用能力。 具体地说,它共同发展出针对图表的技能,能够捕捉可重复使用的推理知识和可执行的工具,从而扩展代理的视觉和数字能力. 技能因此编码了如何解释,而工具则扩展了代理人可以执行的功能,使得获得的能力得以保留,并在相关的图表实例中有效地应用。

blocks.en:
Beyond capability acquisition, a complementary challenge lies in how to efficiently organize and execute these capabilities. Conventional ReAct-style agents repeatedly interleave reasoning, tool invocation, and observation react . In chart reasoning, many tasks require global reasoning to determine what should be measured, but once the target and procedure are established, the remaining computation often consists of locally structured visual operations with stable dependencies. Executing each intermediate step through the ReAct loop therefore requires routing tool outputs back through the MLLM, introducing additional model–tool interaction overhead. We introduce Self-Evolving Local Toolchains (SELT) to address this issue. Through SELT, ChartEvo evolves and preserves validated local Tool compositions as reusable execution structures, enabling structured procedures to execute with fewer MLLM-mediated tool interactions while retaining the flexibility of dynamic Tool composition for previously unseen cases. Skills capture reusable reasoning knowledge, Tools expand executable capabilities, and SELT organize how these capabilities are locally composed and executed. ChartEvo therefore evolves not only the agent’s capability boundary but also the execution structure through which these capabilities are applied. Comprehensive experiments validate the effectiveness of ChartEvo for long-tail chart reasoning and its ability to control the execution overhead of tool-augmented reasoning.
Our contributions are summarized as follows:

除了获得能力外,一个补充挑战在于如何有效地组织和实施这些能力。 传统ReAct 式的代理商多次互换推理、工具引用和观察反应。 在图表推理中,许多任务需要全局推理来决定应该测量什么,但一旦目标和程序确定,剩下的计算往往包括具有稳定依赖性的局部结构的视觉操作. 因此,通过ReAct循环执行每个中间步骤需要通过MLLM返回路由工具输出,引入额外的模型-工具交互管理。 我们引入了自我发展的地方工具链(SELT)来解决这个问题。 通过 SELT, ChartEvo 演化并保存已验证的本地 工具构成作为可重复使用的执行结构,使结构化的程序能够以较少的 MLLM 介质工具交互方式执行,同时保留动态工具构成在以前未见的情况下的灵活性. 技能捕捉可重复使用的推理知识,工具扩展可执行能力,SELT组织这些能力如何在当地组成和执行. 图表 因此,埃沃不仅会发展代理人的能力界限,而且还会发展运用这些能力的执行结构。 综合实验验证了ChartEvo对长尾图推理的有效性及其控制工具强化推理执行间接费用的能力.

blocks.en: 2.1 Chart Question Answering
blocks.zh: 2.1 图问题 答复

blocks.en: Early CQA studies formulated chart understanding as task-specific visual question answering, progressing from synthetic charts and template-based questions figureqa ; DVQA to real-world charts and more complex numerical and logical reasoning PlotQA ; LEAFQA ; chartqa . Vision-language pretraining further enabled more general chart understanding through derendering and structured representations matcha ; unichart .
blocks.zh: 早期的CQA研究将图表理解为任务特定视觉问题的答案,从合成图表和模板问题图qa; DVQA 到现实世界的图表以及更复杂的数字和逻辑推理 PlotQA; LEAFQA; Chartqa. 视觉语言预训进一步通过演示和结构化的表达方式使图表理解更加笼统。

blocks.en: With the rise of MLLMs, recent studies have adapted general-purpose models to CQA through chart-specific instruction tuning and multimodal alignment chartllama ; chartinstruct ; chartassisstant , while increasingly challenging benchmarks expose persistent limitations in precise visual and numerical reasoning chartbench ; chartx ; CharXiv ; chartqapro . Most recently, ChartAgent addresses such limitations through tool-augmented visual reasoning chartagent . However, its reliance on predefined tools and usage strategies makes manual capability engineering difficult to scale across long-tail charts with diverse structures and reasoning requirements, motivating us to explore RSI for autonomously expanding agent capabilities.

blocks.en: 2.2 Recursive Self - Improvement
blocks.zh: 2.2 递归自我——改进

blocks.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) studies how AI systems leverage self-generated experience to improve their capabilities. Existing research explores complementary pathways, including updating model parameters through self-generated data and reinforcement learning spin ; lsp ; spell , as well as evolving the external systems that mediate agent behavior. We focus on the latter. Gödel Agent enables agents to recursively modify their logic and behavior, while Meta-Harness further treats the entire agent harness as an optimization object, extending self-improvement to the system level godel ; metaharness .
blocks.zh: 递归自我改进(RSI)研究AI系统如何利用自我生成的经验来提高自身的能力. 现有研究探索了互补路径,包括通过自生成的数据和强化学习旋转来更新模型参数;Isp;拼写,以及演化调解代理行为的外部系统. 我们侧重于后者。 Gödel Agent使代理能够递归性地修改其逻辑和行为,而Meta-Harness进一步将整个代理吊带视为优化对象,将自我改进延伸至系统级godel ;metaharness .

blocks.en: Recent work increasingly instantiates such improvement through modular and reusable agent capabilities skillsmith ; coevoskill ; anything2skill ; managing . SkillForge, SkillOpt, and MetaSkill-Evolve enable agents to construct and refine reusable skills from execution experience skillforge ; skillopt ; metaskill . In parallel, early studies such as CREATOR and LATM established autonomous tool creation creator ; latm , while recent self-evolving agents increasingly incorporate autonomous tool discovery, construction, repair, and maintenance toolmaker ; stella ; toolmaking ; toolscope . Building on these advances, we jointly evolve chart-specific Skills and Tools for long-tail chart reasoning, while learning reusable local tool-call chains for efficient execution.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作越来越多地通过模块化和可再利用的代理能力技能匠、技能技能、任何2技能、管理来迅速改进。 SkillForge、SkillOpt和MetaSkill-Evolve使代理商能够从执行经验中构建和完善可重复使用的技能;fillopt;metaskill。 与此同时,CREATOR和LATM等早期研究建立了自主工具创建者;latm,而最近的自我演化剂越来越多地包括自主工具的发现、构建、维修和维护工具制造者;stella;工具制作;工具镜。 在这些进展的基础上,我们共同发展了针对图表的技能和工具,用于长尾图推理,同时学习可重复使用的本地工具呼叫链,以高效执行.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: ChartEvo treats the external harness of a chart-reasoning agent as the object of continual self-evolution. Given a chart image I I and a question q q , the underlying model reasons with the current harness to produce an answer. In ChartEvo, the harness consists of Skills, Tools, and Self-Evolving Local Toolchains (SELT). Skills encode reusable chart-specific reasoning and capability-use knowledge, Tools provide executable visual and numerical operations, and SELT persist validated compositions of Tool calls together with their execution dependencies. Skills and Tools thus define the reasoning knowledge and executable capabilities available to the agent, while SELT organize how these capabilities are composed and executed.
blocks.zh: ChartEvo将图解剂的外部利用视为持续自我演变的对象。 鉴于一个图表I和一个问题q q, 基本模型的原因 与当前使用 生成一个答案。 在ChartEvo中,牵引装置包括技能,工具,以及自演本地工具链(SELT). 技能编码可重复使用的图表特定推理和能力使用知识,工具提供可执行的视觉和数字操作,SELT坚持对工具调用及其执行依赖的验证组成. 因此,技能和工具界定了代理人可用的推理知识和可执行能力,而SELT则组织这些能力的构成和执行。

(A) Harness self-evolution jointly updates Skills, Tools, and SELT using answer evaluation and execution feedback, retaining validated updates for subsequent rounds. (B) With the harness frozen at test time, the rose-chart example illustrates five local reasoning stages within a single SELT invocation.
blocks.zh: 图3: ChartEvo. (A) Harness自演技联合更新技能,工具,SELT使用解答评价和执行反馈,为后续各轮保留经验证的更新. (B) 由于在试验时吊带被冻结,玫瑰图的例子说明了单一SELT引用中五个局部推理阶段。

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 3 , ChartEvo formulates harness-level recursive self-improvement as an iterative outer-loop process. Given the current harness and its execution outcomes on chart-reasoning tasks, an agentic proposer introduces or revises Skills, Tools, and SELT. Validated updates are persisted into the next harness state, which is subsequently reused for chart reasoning and serves as the basis for further harness evolution.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,ChartEvo将拉带级的递归自我改进作为迭代的外倾过程。 鉴于目前对图表编制任务的利用及其执行结果,一名代理提议人介绍或修订技能、工具以及SELT。 经验证的更新一直持续到下一个利用状态,随后再用于图表推理,并作为进一步利用演变的基础。

blocks.en: During self-evolution, supervision signals are used to evaluate execution outcomes and guide harness updates. After evolution, the resulting harness is deployed for inference on unseen chart instances. Overall, ChartEvo instantiates the agent as a Model + Evolving Harness system: the model serves as the general reasoning core, while the harness progressively accumulates Skills, Tools, and SELT to acquire new capabilities and more structured execution patterns for long-tail chart reasoning.
blocks.zh: 在自演化期间,使用监督信号来评价执行结果并指导利用最新情况。 演化后,将使用由此产生的工具来推断未见图例。 总体而言,ChartEvo即时将代理作为Model + Evolutioning Harness系统:该模型充当一般推理核心,而牵引器则逐渐积累技能,工具,SELT以获得新的能力和更有条理的执行模式,用于长尾图推理.

blocks.en: 3.2 Harness Recursive Self-Improvement
blocks.zh: 3.2 敏捷性自我改进

blocks.en: ChartEvo starts self-evolution from initial harness ℋ 0 \mathcal{H}_{0} containing a set of generic chart-processing Tools. These Tools provide the basic primitives for bootstrapping chart reasoning, while task-specific capabilities are progressively acquired through self-evolution. At evolution step t t , the current harness ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} is used to solve a task, producing both a prediction and its execution trajectory τ t \tau_{t} . The agentic proposer jointly considers the final answer, task-level evaluation feedback, and the observed execution trajectory to analyze the behavior of the current harness and identify components that require further improvement. This joint observation allows the proposer to assess both task-level correctness and the reliability of the execution process, including cases where an apparently acceptable prediction is supported by an unreliable trajectory.
blocks.zh: ChartEvo从初始控制器H 0\ mathcal{H}_{0}开始自我演化,包含一组通用的图表处理工具. 这些工具为拖曳图推理提供了基本的原始,而任务特定的能力则通过自我演化逐渐获得. 在演化步骤 t 时, 当前带带 H t\ mathcal{ H}_{t} 用于解决一个任务, 生成一个预测及其执行轨迹\ t t} 。 代理求婚者联合考虑最终答案,任务级评价反馈,以及观测到的执行轨迹,以分析当前拉带的行为,并确定需要进一步改进的组件. 这一联合观察使提议者能够评估任务层面的正确性和执行过程的可靠性,包括显然可以接受的预测得到不可靠的轨迹支持的情况。

blocks.en: Based on the current harness, its execution trajectory, and the supervision available during self-evolution, the agentic proposer can introduce new harness components or revise existing Skills, Tools, and SELT. ChartEvo allows multiple component types to evolve jointly within the same step, enabling coordinated updates to reasoning knowledge, executable capabilities, and execution structures. A proposal may therefore span multiple harness components and be evaluated as a coordinated update to the current harness. Ground-truth answers are available during self-evolution for task evaluation and candidate validation, while no ground-truth solution traces are provided.
blocks.zh: 根据目前的牵引力、其执行轨迹和自我演化期间可用的监督,代理提议人可以引入新的牵引力组件或修改现有的技能、工具和SELT。 图表 Evo允许多个组件类型在同一步骤内共同演化,能够协调更新到推理知识,可执行能力和执行结构. 因此,一项提案可能涉及多个利用组件,并被评价为对当前利用的协调更新。 在任务评估和候选人验证过程中可以找到地面真相答案,但没有提供地面真相解决方案痕迹。

blocks.en: Candidate updates are validated by re-executing the task under the updated harness. Both the resulting task outcome and the corresponding execution trajectory are examined to determine whether the updated harness behaves as intended. Validated components and structures are then persisted into ℋ t + 1 \mathcal{H}_{t+1} , which becomes the basis for subsequent execution and further self-evolution. Through repeated execution, analysis, proposal or revision, and validation, ChartEvo recursively evolves its harness over successive tasks, such that subsequent proposals are made over an already evolved harness.
blocks.zh: 候选人更新通过重新执行更新后带下的任务来验证. 对由此产生的任务结果和相应的执行轨迹都加以审查,以确定更新的牵引装置是否按照预期进行。 验证的组件和结构随后被坚持到Ht + 1\ mathcal{H}_{t+1},这成为后续执行和进一步自我演变的基础. ChartEvo通过反复执行、分析、提议或修订以及验证,对接连不断的任务进行再演化,从而在已经演化的利用的基础上提出后续建议。

blocks.en: 3.3 Skill and Tool Evolution
blocks.zh: 3.3 技能和工具演变

blocks.en:
ChartEvo treats Skills and Tools as two complementary carriers of harness capabilities. Skills encode reusable reasoning and capability-use knowledge, guiding the model in how to interpret, select, and use available capabilities. Tools provide executable visual and numerical operations that transform chart information into structured evidence consumable by subsequent reasoning. Together, they define the reasoning knowledge and executable capabilities available to the current harness.
During self-evolution, agentic proposer determines whether an observed deficiency primarily arises from how existing capabilities are composed and used, or from the lack of an executable evidence capability. When the available Tools can already provide the required information but their selection, invocation, or use does not support correct reasoning, evolution primarily targets Skills. When the existing Tool set cannot provide the required structured evidence, or when a Tool exhibits incorrect behavior, insufficient coverage, or an inadequate output interface, the proposer introduces or revises Tools. Existing components are revised when their intended semantics remain valid, whereas new components are introduced when the required reasoning pattern or executable capability is semantically distinct from those already available.
blocks.zh:
图表Evo 处理 技能和工具是两个互补的利用能力载体。 技能编码可重复使用的推理和能力使用知识,指导模型如何解释、选择和使用现有能力。 工具提供可执行的视觉和数字操作,通过后续推理将图表信息转化为结构化的证据消耗. 它们共同界定了目前掌握的推理知识和可执行能力。
在自我演进期间,代理人提议者确定观察到的缺陷主要来自现有能力的构成和使用方式,还是来自缺乏可执行的证据能力。 当可用的工具已经能够提供所需的信息,但其选择、引用或使用并不支持正确的推理时,演化主要针对技能。 当现有的工具集无法提供所需的结构化证据,或者当一个工具显示不正确的行为,覆盖不足,或输出界面不足时,提议者引入或修改工具. 现有组成部分在预期语义仍然有效时加以修订,而新的组成部分则在所需推理模式或可执行能力与现有能力明显不同时加以采用。

blocks.en: Skill and Tool evolution can be coupled within the same self-evolution step, allowing newly introduced or revised executable capabilities to be incorporated into corresponding reasoning and capability-use knowledge. Candidate Skills and Tools are re-executed and validated under the updated harness, with Tools additionally checked for executable behavior. Validated updates are persisted in the harness and remain available for reasoning and further evolution. While Skill and Tool evolution expands the capabilities available to the harness, stable multi-step execution structures over these capabilities are captured through SELT.
blocks.zh: 技能和工具演化可以在同一自演化步骤内结合,使新引进或修订可执行能力被纳入相应的推理和能力使用知识. 候选人技能和工具在更新的控制下重新执行和验证,同时对工具进行可执行行为的额外检查。 经核实的更新在利用中一直存在,并仍然可供推理和进一步发展。 虽然技能与工具演化可以扩大利用的能力,但通过SELT可以捕捉这些能力之上的稳定多步骤执行结构。

blocks.en: 3.4 Self-Evolving Local Toolchains
blocks.zh: 3.4 自我演变的本地工具链

blocks.en: Self-Evolving Local Toolchains (SELT) persist validated Tool compositions as reusable execution structures, avoiding repeated reconstruction of the same Tool-call patterns through model-mediated interaction. Each SELT represents a bounded executable transformation with explicit inputs, outputs, execution order, and internal Tool dependencies. The boundedness of a SELT is defined by its functional contract: the Agent resolves the task-specific target and required arguments, after which the SELT executes the structured transformation and returns its designated output.
blocks.zh: 自我演变的本地工具链(SELT)持续有效 工具构成作为可重复使用的执行结构,避免通过模型介质的相互作用重复重建相同的工具调用模式. 每个SELT代表有明确输入、输出、执行命令和内部工具依赖性的有限度可执行的转换。 SELT的边界由它的功能合同来定义: Agent解决任务特定目标和所需的参数,之后SELT执行结构化的转换并返回其指定的输出.

blocks.en: During self-evolution, the Agent can reuse an existing SELT when an applicable execution structure is available. Otherwise, it dynamically composes individual Tools, coordinating their execution and intermediate results through model interactions. Validated compositions with stable execution structures can subsequently be persisted as new SELT, while existing SELT can be revised as Tools, Skills, or execution requirements evolve. Unlike dynamic Tool composition, SELT delegate inter-step parameter resolution and intermediate output propagation to the runtime, eliminating repeated Agent planning and binding within established Toolchains.
blocks.zh: 在自演化过程中,当存在适用的执行结构时,特工可以重新使用现有的SELT. 否则,它能动态地编程单个工具,通过模型互动协调其执行和中间结果. 具有稳定执行结构的经验证的构成随后可随着新的SELT而持续,而现有的SELT则可随着工具,技能,或执行要求的演进而修订. 不同于动态 工具组成、SELT将跨步骤参数分辨率和中间产出传播到运行时间,消除了重复的代理规划和在既定工具链内的约束。

blocks.en: SELT usage is jointly mediated by Skills, the Agent, and the runtime. Skills maintain the available SELT together with their routing and usage knowledge. The runtime progressively discloses context-relevant candidate SELT according to the current question, execution stage, and accumulated observations, exposing only a relevant subset of the harness capabilities at each decision step. The Agent selects a concrete SELT based on question semantics, available evidence, and Skill-provided routing knowledge, and binds the task-specific arguments required for execution. The runtime then executes the selected SELT while enforcing invocation constraints, Tool versions, and execution checks.
blocks.zh: SELT的使用由技能,代理和运行时间联合调解. 技能保持现有的SELT及其路线和使用知识。 运行时间根据当前的问题、执行阶段和累积的观察结果,逐渐披露了与背景有关的候选人SELT,只披露了每个决策步骤的利用能力的一个相关子集。 特工根据问题语义、现有证据和技能提供的路由知识选择一个混凝土SELT,并绑定执行所需的具体任务论据。 运行时间然后执行选定的 SELT 同时执行引用限制,工具版本和执行检查.

blocks.en: Skills and SELT therefore play complementary roles: Skills specify when and how an execution structure should be used, whereas SELT encode its concrete Tool composition and dependencies. Once the Agent binds the task target, entities, and execution conditions, the selected SELT executes the structured procedure without further model-mediated coordination of internal Tool calls. When no applicable SELT is available, the Agent can fall back to dynamic Tool composition, whose successful execution may drive subsequent SELT evolution.
blocks.zh: 因此,技能和SELT发挥互补作用: 技能说明何时以及如何使用执行结构,而SELT则编码其具体工具的组成和依赖性。 一旦代理绑定任务目标,实体,和执行条件,选定的SELT执行结构化程序,而无需对内部工具呼叫进行进一步的模型调解协调. 在没有可适用的SELT时,Agent可以回归动态工具构成,其成功执行可能会推动后续的SELT演化.

blocks.en: 3.5 Inference with the Evolved Harness
blocks.zh: 3.5 对演化的利用的推论

blocks.en: After self-evolution, ChartEvo fixes the resulting harness and applies it to unseen chart instances. The Agent uses the evolved Skills, Tools, and SELT according to the current question and execution context. When an applicable SELT is available, its persistent execution structure can be directly reused; otherwise, the Agent can dynamically compose Tools to complete the task. To handle unsuccessful execution, ChartEvo supports two fallback conditions: the Agent may proactively switch to direct visual answering when it determines that harness-assisted reasoning can no longer proceed, or the system triggers fallback when the maximum action budget of 15 is reached. In both cases, direct visual answering is performed using only the original chart image and question.
blocks.zh: 在自我进化后,ChartEvo修正了由此产生的绳索,并将其应用于看不见的图表实例. Agent根据当前问题和执行上下文使用进化后的技能,工具,以及SELT. 当可用的 SELT 可用时,其持续执行结构可以直接重复使用;否则,代理可以动态编译工具来完成任务. 为了处理不成功的执行,ChartEvo支持两个倒计时条件:当代理商确定调用辅助推理不能再进行时,可以主动切换到直接的视觉回答,或者当达到15的最大动作预算时系统触发倒计时. 在这两种情况下,直接的视觉回答只使用原始图表图像和问题进行.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate ChartEvo on two chart reasoning benchmarks, ChartBench and ChartX. We focus on Numerical Question Answering (NQA), which demands precise visual evidence extraction and numerical reasoning, providing a comprehensive evaluation of an agent’s chart reasoning capabilities. We select 9 long-tail chart types from ChartBench and 8 from ChartX. For each chart type, we use 100 training questions for self-evolution and evaluate on a total of 450 test questions from ChartBench and 265 from ChartX. Self-evolution is conducted independently for the two benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个图表推理基准来评价图埃沃,图奔驰和图X. 我们侧重于数字问题回答(NQA),它要求精确的视觉证据提取和数字推理,对代理人的图表推理能力进行全面评估. 我们从Chart Bench中选择9种长尾图类型,从Chart X中选择8种. 对于每个图表类型,我们使用100个训练问题进行自我演化,并对来自Chart Bench的总共450个测试问题和来自ChartX的265个测试问题进行评估. 两项基准的自我演变是独立的。

blocks.en: Following common evaluation practices in chart reasoning, we adopt a 5% relative-error tolerance to account for uncertainty in visual representations and numerical readings. After self-evolution, the resulting harness is used for evaluation on the test set. For charts with explicit numerical annotations, the Agent directly performs visual answering.
blocks.zh: 按照图表推理方面的共同评价做法,我们采用5%的相对-反常容忍度,以说明视觉表现和数字读数中的不确定性。 在自演化后,产生的牵引装置用于测试集的评价. 对于带有明确数字说明的图表,代理直接进行视觉解答.

blocks.en: We employ Qwen3.7-Plus as the main Agent and GPT-5.6-Sol as the agentic proposer. The maximum Agent action budget is set to 15. We compare ChartEvo against two groups of baselines: (1) direct MLLMs, including DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash deepseekv41flash , Qwen3.7-Plus qwen37 , Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.8-Max qwen3.8 , Kimi-K2.6, GPT-5.6-Luna, GPT-5.6-Terra, and GPT-5.6-Sol gpt56 ; and (2) chart-specialized methods, including DePlot deplot , TinyChart tinychart , ChartInstruct chartinstruct , ChartVLM chartx , and ChartAgent chartagent .

blocks.en: 4.1 Comparison with State-of-the-art Solvers
blocks.zh: 4.1 与最新解决方案的比较

blocks.en:
Tables 1 and 2 present the comparison of ChartEvo with existing methods on ChartBench and ChartX, respectively.
On ChartBench, ChartEvo achieves an average accuracy of 93.6% across nine long-tail chart types, outperforming its base model, Qwen3.7-Plus, by 45.6 percentage points (93.6% vs. 48.0%), while surpassing all evaluated direct visual MLLMs and chart-specialized models and agents. Notably, ChartEvo achieves the best performance across all nine chart types, with eight reaching at least 90% accuracy, demonstrating consistent improvements across diverse chart structures. For instance, on 3D-stack charts with complex spatial structures, ChartEvo improves accuracy from 14% to 92%.
On ChartX, ChartEvo also demonstrates substantial overall improvements across eight long-tail chart types, achieving an average accuracy of 86.1% and slightly outperforming GPT-5.6-Sol. Improvements over the base model are observed across chart types with diverse visual structures and reasoning requirements. For example, on Radar charts, ChartEvo increases accuracy from 16.7% to 83.3%.
Overall, these results demonstrate that recursively evolving the external harness can substantially improve the capabilities of the underlying model in long-tail chart reasoning.

在图本奇,图 Evo在9种长尾图类型中的平均精度达到93.6%,比其基准模型Quen3.7-Plus的精度高出45.6个百分点(93.6%对48.0%),同时超过了所有被评价的直观MLLM和图表专用模型和剂. 值得注意的是,ChartEvo在所有9种图表类型中都取得了最佳的性能,其中8种至少达到90%的准确度,表明不同图表结构的不断改进。 例如,在具有复杂空间结构的3D层图上,ChartEvo的精度从14%提高到92%。
在图X上,图 Evo还表明,在8种长尾图类型中,总体情况有显著改善,平均精度达到86.1%,略高于GPT-5.6-Sol。 在图表类型中观察到了基础模型的改进,具有不同的视觉结构和推理要求。 例如,在雷达图上,图埃沃的精度从16.7%提高到83.3%。
总的来说,这些结果表明,在长尾图推理中,不断演变的外部利用可大大提高基本模型的能力。

blocks.en: 4.2 Cost Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 成本分析

blocks.en: We evaluate the inference cost of ChartEvo against direct visual MLLMs using completion tokens and wall-clock time. All results are averaged over the same 715 test questions from ChartBench and ChartX, providing a consistent basis for comparing inference overhead.
blocks.zh: 我们利用完成符号和墙钟时间,对照直接视觉的MLLM,评估ChartEvo的推论成本。 所有结果均以图本奇和图X相同的715个测试问题为平均值,为比较推算间接费用提供了一致的基础.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , ChartEvo requires an average of 2,907 completion tokens and 68.76 seconds per question, representing an 18% increase in tokens and an additional 26.05 seconds compared with its base model, Qwen3.7-Plus. Its token consumption remains below Kimi-K2.6 and DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash, and is comparable to Qwen3.8-Max, while its latency is lower than DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash. The additional overhead is associated with multi-step Agent–Tool interactions, which enable structured evidence acquisition and numerical reasoning. Combined with the substantial accuracy improvements reported above, these results highlight the performance–cost trade-off of ChartEvo: stronger long-tail chart reasoning is achieved with moderate additional token generation, accompanied by increased execution latency.
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,ChartEvo平均需要2,907个完成令牌,每题68.76秒,比其基准型号Qune3.7-Plus增加18%,增加26.05秒. 其象征性消费仍低于Kimi-K2.6和DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash,与Qune3.8-Max相当,而其耐久性则低于DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash. 追加的间接费用与多步骤代理-工具相互作用有关,从而能够有条理地获取证据和进行数字推理。 这些结果加上上文所报告的大量准确性改进,突出了ChartEvo的性能-成本权衡:通过适度的额外象征性生成,加上执行时间的增加,实现了更强的长尾图推理。

blocks.en: To assess Skill and Tool evolution, we perform ablations on five ChartBench chart types: Area, 3D-stacked, Ring, Sector, and Radar multi-fill. We compare five configurations: Base MLLM (Qwen3.7-Plus), Evolved Skill-only, Base Harness, Evolved Tools, and full ChartEvo. Evolved Skill-only incorporates evolved reasoning guidance, Base Harness provides generic executable operations, and Evolved Tools-only includes evolved Tools without evolved Skills. As shown in Table 4 , Evolved Skill-only and Base Harness achieve accuracies of 55.6% and 57.2%, respectively, both outperforming the Base MLLM at 42.8%. Evolved Tools-only further reaches 84.4%, a 27.2 percentage-point improvement over Base Tools.

blocks.en: Despite similar overall accuracy, Skill-only and Base Tools exhibit distinct performance patterns, as shown in Fig. 4 . On Area charts, Skill-only achieves 92%, exceeding Base Tools at 80%, demonstrating the value of chart-specific reasoning guidance. Conversely, Base Tools achieves 94% on Sector charts, compared with 60% for Skill-only, highlighting the importance of executable numerical measurements. These results reveal the complementary roles of Skills and Tools. Both configurations, however, remain below 20% on 3D-stacked charts. With evolved Tools, accuracy increases from 16% to 90% on 3D-stacked and from 44% to 98% on Ring, primarily benefiting from specialized 3D measurement and ring-marker counting capabilities. Meanwhile, Sector maintains 94% accuracy as its required measurements are already supported by existing Tools. Radar multi-fill also remains at 52%, reflecting limitations in Tool coverage and effective invocation. These results indicate that Tool evolution depends on both acquiring the necessary executable capabilities and effectively utilizing them. The full ChartEvo further improves Radar multi-fill accuracy to 88%, demonstrating the benefits of the integrated evolved harness.

blocks.en: To isolate the contribution of Self-Evolving Local Toolchains (SELT), we conduct a controlled ablation on five ChartBench chart types: Area, 3D-stacked, Ring, Sector, and Radar multi-fill. Both configurations retain the same evolved Skills, Tools, and base model, while the variant without SELT relies on dynamic Tool composition instead of persistent Toolchains. As shown in Table 6 , enabling SELT reduces average model API calls from 6.19 to 2.73 (55.9% reduction), while improving accuracy from 91.2% to 94.8%. This comparison evaluates whether reusing validated Tool compositions can reduce repeated model–Tool interactions without compromising reasoning performance.
blocks.zh: 为了分离自演本地工具链(SELT)的贡献,我们对五个图本图类型进行受控的剪切: 区域、3D型、环形、区和雷达多填充。 两种配置都保留了相同的进化的技能,工具,和基础模型,而没有SELT的变体则依赖于动态工具组成而不是持久的工具链. 如表6所示,允许SELT将平均型号API调用率从6.19降至2.73(减少55.9%),而精度则从91.2%降至94.8%。 这种比较评价了重新使用经过验证的工具成分是否能够减少重复的模型–工具相互作用而不损害推理性能.

blocks.en: We analyze the inference behavior of ChartEvo across ChartBench and ChartX. As shown in Table 5 , 77.9% of questions are completed through structured Tool chains, while 9.9% are answered directly through visual inference and 12.2% through fallback. Chain-based answers achieve 98.0% accuracy, indicating the reliability of structured visual and numerical execution. ChartEvo averages 2.30 model API calls and 5.52 underlying Tool calls per question, demonstrating how multiple executable operations can be coordinated with limited model interactions. Together, the controlled ablation and execution statistics characterize the efficiency benefits of persistent SELT and the broad coverage of structured Tool-chain reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们分析ChartEvo跨越Chart Bench和ChartX的推论行为. 如表5所示,77.9%的问题通过结构化工具链完成,9.9%的问题通过视觉推断直接回答,12.2%通过倒置回答。 基于链式的答案达到98.0%的准确度,表明结构化的视觉和数字执行的可靠性. 图表 Evo平均 2.30 模型 API 调用和 5.52 基础工具调用每个问题,演示了多个可执行操作如何与有限的模型交互协调. 受控的停产和执行统计数据加在一起,说明了持续SELT的效率效益和结构化工具链推理的广泛范围。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This paper presents ChartEvo, a harness-level recursive self-improvement framework for long-tail chart reasoning. By evolving Skills, Tools, and Self-Evolving Local Toolchains, ChartEvo enables autonomous capability acquisition and efficient execution. On ChartBench and ChartX, it improves accuracy over Qwen3.7-Plus by 45.6% and 32.5%, respectively, while SELT substantially reduce model calls without accuracy loss. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of harness-level self-improvement for long-tail chart adaptation.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍ChartEvo,是长尾图推理的牵引级递归自改进框架. ChartEvo通过不断发展的技能、工具和自我发展的地方工具链,使自主能力获得和有效执行成为可能。 在Chart Bench和ChartX上,它使Qune3.7-Plus的精度分别提高了45.6%和32.5%,而SELT则在不丢失精度的情况下大量减少模型调用. 这些结果显示,对长尾图的调整进行利用水平自我改进是有效的。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The effectiveness of ChartEvo depends partly on the coverage and diversity of the data used for self-evolution. Limited training examples may lead to overly specialized harness components, while conservative validation and admission criteria can restrict the acquisition of new capabilities. Furthermore, substantial distribution shifts between evolution and test data may limit the transferability of evolved Skills, Tools, and SELT. Improving the robustness and generalization of harness-level self-improvement remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: ChartEvo的有效性部分取决于用于自我演变的数据的覆盖面和多样性. 有限的培训实例可能导致过度专业化的利用组件,而保守的验证和录取标准会限制获得新的能力。 此外,演化与测试数据之间的大量分布变化可能限制演化后的技能、工具和SELT的可转让性。 提高利用水平自强的稳健性和普及性,仍然是今后工作的重要方向.

blocks.en: Appendix A Chart Question Answering Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 附录A 图表

blocks.en: Chart Question Answering (CQA) is formulated as a multimodal reasoning task in which a system is given a chart image ℐ i \mathcal{I}_{i} and a corresponding natural language question 𝒬 i \mathcal{Q}_{i} , and is required to produce an answer 𝒜 i \mathcal{A}_{i} . In this work, we focus on Numerical Question Answering (NQA), where the answer is a numerical value that must be inferred from the visual and quantitative information encoded in the chart. Solving these questions may require identifying relevant chart elements, extracting numerical evidence, and performing quantitative reasoning to derive the final answer.
blocks.zh: 图表问答(CQA)是作为一个多式联运推理任务制定的,其中系统被赋予图表图像 I i\ mathcal{I}_{i}和相应的自然语言问题 Q i\ mathcal{i},并且需要生成答案 A i\mathcal{A}_{i}. 在这部作品中,我们专注于数字问答(NQA),其中答案是一个数字值,必须从图中编码的视觉和定量信息中推断出来. 解决这些问题可能需要确定相关的图表要素,提取数字证据,并进行定量推理以得出最终答案.

blocks.en: Appendix B Experimental Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 细节

blocks.en: B.1 Benchmark Selection and Data Organization
blocks.zh: B.1 基准选择和数据组织

blocks.en: We evaluate ChartEvo on two chart question-answering benchmarks, ChartBench and ChartX, both of which cover diverse chart types and provide numerical question-answer pairs. We focus on Numerical Question Answering (NQA) and select chart types where the base model exhibits relatively weak performance for subsequent self-evolution and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个图表问答基准来评价图表Evo, Chart Bench 和 ChartX, 它们都涵盖不同的图表类型,并提供数字问答对. 我们注重数字问答(NQA),并选择基本模型表现相对薄弱的图表类型,用于后续的自我演化和评价.

blocks.en: Specifically, we first evaluate Qwen3.7-Plus on the randomly selected 100 questions from train splits of ChartBench and ChartX to obtain per-type NQA accuracy. Chart types with a baseline accuracy below 85% are selected as long-tail chart types. This procedure yields 9 chart types from ChartBench and 8 from ChartX.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,我们首先在从图本奇和图X的列车分割中随机选择的100个问题上评价Qune3.7-Plus,以获得每型NQA的精确度. 基准精度低于85%的图表类型作为长尾图类型选择. 这一程序从图奔驰产生9种图表类型,从图X产生8种.

blocks.en: For each selected chart type, we use 100 training questions to drive harness-level self-evolution and evaluate the evolved system on the corresponding test questions. Self-evolution is conducted independently for ChartBench and ChartX, with separate evolving harnesses for the two benchmarks. The resulting evaluation sets contain 450 NQA questions across 9 chart types in ChartBench and 265 NQA questions across 8 chart types in ChartX.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个选定的图表类型,我们使用100个训练问题来驱动牵引级自演,并在相应的测试问题上评价进化的系统. 自行演化是针对Chart Bench和ChartX独立进行的,为这两个基准有单独的不断发展的牵引. 由此形成的评价集包含图奔奇9种图型的450个NQA问题和图X8种图型的265个NQA问题.

blocks.en: B.2 Self-Evolution Implementation
blocks.zh: B.2 自发执行

blocks.en: B.2.1 Training Organization.
blocks.zh: B.2.1 培训组织。

blocks.en:
For each long-tail chart type, we partition 100 training questions into 10 clusters of 10 questions each. Self-evolution proceeds sequentially across clusters, with the current harness used to execute the tasks in each cluster. The resulting answers, correctness feedback, and execution trajectories are collected to guide subsequent analysis and evolution.
Within each cluster, harness evolution may involve multiple iterations. After each update, the system re-evaluates relevant tasks to assess whether previous failures have been resolved and continues refining the harness to address remaining failures. Once most failures within the cluster have been addressed, the process advances to the next cluster. Verified and accepted harness updates are persisted, allowing subsequent clusters to build upon the accumulated Skills, Tools, and SELT.
blocks.zh:
对于每个长尾图类型,我们将100个训练问题分成10组,每组10个问题. 自我演变依次在各组进行,目前用来执行每个组的任务。 由此得到的答案,正确性反馈,以及执行轨迹被收集,以指导后续的分析和演化.
在每个集群中,利用演化可能涉及多个迭代. 在每次更新后,系统都重新评估相关任务,以评估先前的失败是否已经解决,并继续改进处理剩余失败的方法。 一旦本组内的大多数失败得到处理,进程就会推进到下一个组。 不断更新经核实和接受的绳索,使随后的集群能够利用积累的技能、工具以及SELT。

blocks.en: B.2.2 Failure Analysis and Harness Updates
blocks.zh: B.2.2 失败分析和利用最新情况

blocks.en: Failure Identification. After completing each training cluster, the system identifies tasks requiring further investigation based on final answers, correctness feedback, and execution trajectories. For NQA tasks, predictions with a relative error exceeding 5% are marked as incorrect, while ground-truth values of zero are handled separately to avoid division by zero. Additionally, predictions with errors between 3% and 5% are flagged for further inspection, as numerically correct answers may still arise from unreliable execution trajectories. Beyond answer correctness, the system also examines fallback behavior and the task coverage of existing Tool-call chains. Together, these signals identify tasks that are not yet reliably handled by the current harness and guide subsequent evolution.
blocks.zh: 失败识别。 在完成每组培训后,系统根据最终答案、正确性反馈和执行轨迹确定需要进一步调查的任务。 对于NQA任务,相对误差超过5%的预测被标记为不正确,而零的地面真实值则单独处理,以避免除以零. 此外,有3%至5%之间错误的预测被标出供进一步检查,因为数字正确的答复可能仍然产生于不可靠的执行轨迹。 除了回答正确性以外,该系统还审查倒置行为和现有工具呼叫链的任务范围。 这些信号共同确定了目前尚未可靠处理的任务,并指导了随后的发展。

blocks.en: Failure Clustering and Trajectory Analysis. The agentic proposer analyzes the collected execution trajectories to identify recurring failure patterns across training questions. Rather than relying solely on numerical discrepancies, the analysis considers the Agent’s action sequences, Tool invocations, and returned observations to locate the underlying sources of failure. These may include incorrect Tool selection, parameter binding, or evidence utilization despite sufficient existing capabilities; missing Tools for extracting necessary visual or numerical evidence; or ineffective execution order and information dependencies across multiple Tool calls. By clustering failures with shared characteristics, the proposer identifies recurring capability gaps that can guide reusable harness improvements across tasks.
blocks.zh: 失败集群与轨迹分析. 代理求婚者分析所收集的处决轨迹,以识别整个训练问题反复出现的失败模式. 分析不是仅仅依靠数字差异,而是考虑代理人的动作序列、工具引用和返回的观测结果,以找出失败的根源。 这些可能包括:尽管现有能力充分,但工具选择、参数约束或证据使用不正确;缺少必要的视觉或数字证据提取工具;或多个工具调用中执行命令和信息依赖无效。 通过将具有共同特点的失败归为一组,提议者确定了反复出现的能力差距,这些差距可以指导对各项任务的再利用改进。

blocks.en: Harness Updates and Verification. Based on the identified failure patterns, the agentic proposer proposes targeted harness updates by revising existing Skills, Tools, and SELT or introducing new components. A single evolution iteration may jointly update multiple component types to coordinate capability acquisition, capability utilization, and execution structure. Candidate updates are evaluated by re-executing relevant training tasks with the modified harness and examining both answer correctness and the resulting execution trajectories. Verification considers whether previous failures have been resolved, whether the Agent correctly invokes the updated components, whether Tool executions produce useful evidence, and whether tasks previously unsupported by harness-based reasoning become solvable. Accepted updates are persisted, while remaining failures may trigger further rounds of analysis and evolution within the same training cluster.
blocks.zh: 利用最新消息和核查。 根据已查明的失败模式,代理提议者提议通过修订现有技能、工具、SELT或引入新的组件,进行有针对性的利用更新。 单一演化迭代可联合更新多个组成部分类型,以协调能力获取、能力利用和执行结构。 对候选人的更新情况进行评价,方法是利用经修改的带子重新执行相关培训任务,并审查答案正确性和由此产生的执行轨迹。 核查考虑以前的失败是否已经解决,代理人是否正确引用了更新的组件,工具执行是否产生有用的证据,以及以前不通过基于利用的推理支持的任务是否变得可以溶解. 接受的更新仍然存在,而其余的失败则可能引发同一培训组内的进一步分析和演变。

blocks.zh: B.2.4 说明性自我演变实例

blocks.en: Figure 5: Illustrative self-evolution of ChartEvo on a dot-ring chart. An initial measurement failure triggers joint Skill, Tool, and SELT evolution, enabling accurate dot-count-based reasoning and capability reuse across additional chart instances.
blocks.zh: 图5:点环图上图埃沃图的图示性自演. 初步的测量失败触发了技能、工具和SELT联合演化,使得基于点数的推理和能力能够在其他图表中重新使用。

blocks.en: Figure 5 illustrates how ChartEvo acquires reusable harness capabilities through self-evolution using a dot-ring chart question asking for the approximate percentage of Spotify, with a reference answer of 40%. In the initial execution, the Agent first invokes annotate_legend to identify the target series, followed by get_marker_rgb to extract its corresponding color. It then applies measure_pie_segment_percentage to estimate the target proportion from pixel area, obtaining 33.68%. Although the target series and its color are correctly identified and the measurement Tool returns an accepted status, the final prediction deviates from the reference answer. Trajectory analysis reveals a mismatch between the measurement strategy and the chart’s visual encoding: proportions are represented by discrete dot counts rather than pixel area.
blocks.zh: 图5说明ChartEvo如何通过自我演化获得可再利用的利用能力,使用点环图问题,询问Spotify的大致百分比,参考答案为40%。 在初始执行中,代理先引用注释_legend来识别目标序列,然后获取_marker_rgb来提取其相应的颜色. 然后,它应用度量_pie_segment_百分比来估计来自像素区域的目标比例,得到33.68%. 虽然目标系列及其颜色被正确识别,测量工具返回一个被接受的状态,但最终预测偏离了参考答案. 轨迹分析揭示了测量策略与图的视觉编码不匹配:比例以离散点数而不是像素区域为代表.

blocks.en: To address this failure, ChartEvo jointly evolves multiple harness components. A new Tool, count_ring_dots_and_compute_percentage , is introduced to count target-colored dots and total dots within the same ring and compute their ratio. A corresponding Skill, ring-dot-percentage , provides capability selection and usage guidance for dot-ring charts and approximate percentage questions. Meanwhile, the existing legend annotation and color extraction Tools are composed with the new counting Tool into a three-step SELT, preserving the complete measurement procedure as a reusable execution structure. These coordinated updates extend the harness with a measurement capability tailored to discrete-dot encoding, together with the knowledge and execution structure required to utilize it.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一失败,ChartEvo联合演化出多种牵引组件. 采用新工具,计数_ring_dots_和_compute_百分比,在同一环内计算目标色点和总点,并计算其比例. 相应的技能(环点百分比)为点环图表和大约百分比问题提供能力选择和使用指导。 同时,现有的传说注释和色彩提取工具与新的计数工具组成一个三步SELT,保留完整的测量程序作为可重复使用的执行结构. 这些经协调的更新扩展了这种装置,使之具有适合离散点编码的测量能力,以及利用这种装置所需的知识和执行结构。

blocks.en: When executing the original question with the evolved harness, the Agent follows the three-step Tool chain to identify the target series, extract its color, and count the corresponding dots. The new Tool identifies 331 target dots out of 830 total dots, yielding 39.8795%, which is rounded to 40% in accordance with the question’s approximate wording. The same persisted counting capability is further reused on three additional dot-ring charts involving smartphone operating systems, TV genres, and TV streaming, producing answers of 35%, 30%, and 40%, respectively. This example illustrates how ChartEvo transforms an observed measurement failure into a persistent harness capability that can be applied across subsequent chart instances.
blocks.zh: 在用进化的吊带执行原始问题时,Agent遵循三步工具链来识别目标系列,提取其颜色,并计算相应的点数. 新工具在830个总点中确定了331个目标点,达到39.8795%,按照问题大致措辞四舍五入为40%。 在涉及智能手机操作系统、电视流线和电视流线的另外三张点环图上,同样的持续计数能力被进一步重复使用,生成的答案分别为35%、30%和40%。 这个例子说明,ChartEvo如何将观察到的测量故障转化为可适用于以后图表实例的持久利用能力。

blocks.en: B.3 Ablation Study Configurations
blocks.zh: B.3 读取研究配置

blocks.en: All ablation settings use Qwen3.7-Plus as the base model and are evaluated on the same test questions under a unified 5% relative-error tolerance. Specifically, Base MLLM performs direct visual answering without any harness components. Evolved Skill-only uses evolved Skills to guide reasoning without access to Tools or SELT. Base Harness includes the initial Skills and Tools, without SELT. Evolved Tools retains the initial Skills while replacing the initial Tool collection with its evolved counterpart, again without SELT. Finally, ChartEvo (Full) employs the complete evolved harness, comprising evolved Skills, the same evolved Tools, and persisted SELT.
blocks.zh: 所有衰竭设置都使用Quen3.7-Plus作为基准模型,并在统一5%的相对-error容忍度下,在同一测试问题上进行评估. 具体来说,Base MLLM在没有任何牵引组件的情况下进行直接的视觉应答. Evolved Skill只使用演化的Swills来指导推理,而无需访问Toles或SELT. Base Harness包括最初的技能和工具,没有SELT. Evolutioned Tools保留了初始技能,同时将初始工具集替换为已进化的对应工具,同样没有SELT. 最后,ChartEvo (Full) 采用了完全进化的牵引装置,包括进化的技巧,同样的进化的工具,并坚持SELT.

blocks.en: Appendix C Harness Specifications
blocks.zh: 附录C 规格

blocks.en: C.1 Harness Representation and Organization
blocks.zh: C.1 代表性和组织

blocks.en: ChartEvo organizes the capabilities acquired through self-evolution into a persistent harness comprising Skills, Tools, and Self-Evolving Local Toolchains (SELT). Each component adopts a representation suited to its role. Skills are stored as metadata-annotated textual knowledge, specifying applicability conditions, reasoning guidance, and knowledge for capability selection and utilization. Tools are registered as executable components with explicit input and output interfaces for visual and numerical processing. SELT preserve validated Tool-call compositions as reusable execution structures with defined functional contracts, execution order, and internal dependencies. Together, these components form an extensible collection of capabilities accessible to the Agent during reasoning.
blocks.zh: ChartEvo将通过自我进化而获得的能力组织成由技能、工具和自我演变的本地工具链(SELT)组成的持久利用。 每个组成部分都采用适合其作用的表述方式。 技能作为元数据附加说明的文字知识储存,具体说明适用性条件、推理指导和能力选择和利用知识。 工具被注册为可执行组件,有清晰的输入和输出接口,用于视觉和数字处理. SELT保留了经验证的工具调用构成,作为具有界定的职能合同、执行命令和内部依赖关系的可重复使用的执行结构。 这些组成部分合在一起,构成了代理人在推理时可以使用的各种能力的可扩展集。

blocks.en: Harness components are connected through explicit references that coordinate knowledge, executable capabilities, and execution structures. Skills provide reasoning guidance for particular chart structures and question types, together with the selection and usage knowledge of relevant Tools and the registration and routing information of SELT. Guided by these Skills, the Agent can invoke individual Tools, dynamically compose multiple Tool calls, or reuse persisted SELT. Each SELT specifies its constituent Tool calls, execution order, and parameter dependencies across steps, enabling multiple executable capabilities to operate within a predefined structure. These cross-component references allow reasoning knowledge, executable capabilities, and execution structures to be organized and utilized together.
blocks.zh: 通过协调知识、可执行能力和执行结构的明确参考,将利用性部分联系起来。 技能为特定图表结构和问题类型提供推理指导,同时提供相关工具的选择和使用知识以及SELT的注册和路由信息。 在这些技能的指引下,特工可以引用单个工具,动态地编译多个工具调用,或者再利用持续SELT. 每个SELT指定其组成 工具调用,执行命令,以及跨步骤的参数依赖,使多个可执行能力能够在预先定义的结构内运行. 这些交叉组成部分的参考文献使推理知识、可执行能力和执行结构得以共同组织和利用。

blocks.en: Verified and accepted harness updates are persisted in the corresponding asset stores and remain available throughout subsequent training stages and inference tasks. Existing components may be revised to accommodate new capability requirements, while new Skills, Tools, or SELT can be introduced to extend the range of supported tasks and execution patterns. When an evolution iteration involves multiple component types, their associated guidance, executable capabilities, and execution structures can be updated jointly and retained as interconnected assets. This persistent organization enables the harness to accumulate reusable capabilities across successive evolution iterations and supports subsequent reasoning with the expanded capability repertoire.
blocks.zh: 在相应的资产储存库中,不断更新经核实和接受的利用情况,并在随后的培训阶段和推论任务中随时提供。 现有组成部分可加以修订,以适应新的能力要求,同时可采用新的技能、工具或SELT,以扩大支助任务和执行模式的范围。 当一个演化迭代涉及多个组件类型时,其相关指导,可执行能力,以及执行结构可以作为互联资产共同更新和保留. 这种持久的组织使这种利用能够积累各种连续演化迭代的可再利用能力,并用扩大的能力来支持其后的推理。

blocks.en: C.2 Hierarchical Retrieval and Progressive Disclosure
blocks.zh: C.2 分级检索和逐步披露

blocks.en: As the harness evolves, its growing collection of Skills, Tools, and SELT introduces an increasing amount of potentially relevant knowledge and executable capabilities. ChartEvo employs hierarchical retrieval and progressive disclosure to construct a task-relevant execution context, selectively exposing harness information according to task characteristics and evolving execution states.
blocks.zh: 随着这种技术的不断发展,它越来越多地收集技能、工具和SELT,引进了越来越多的潜在相关知识和可执行能力。 图表 Evo利用分级检索和逐步披露来构建与任务相关的执行背景,有选择地根据任务特点和不断变化的执行状态来披露利用信息。

blocks.en: ChartEvo adopts a two-stage retrieval mechanism to select relevant Skills without loading the entire Skill Store. In the first stage, Skill frontmatter metadata is used to filter and rank candidates based on chart type, question characteristics, and applicability conditions. Only the selected Skills are subsequently loaded for reasoning. For each question, the system retrieves at most three Skills, comprising up to one universal Skill and two chart-specific Skills, with a combined Skill-body budget of 1,600 tokens. Near-duplicate Skills with similarity exceeding 0.80 are suppressed, while chart- or feature-specific matches are prioritized over overly general or mismatched candidates. This mechanism limits the knowledge introduced into the Agent’s context while preserving guidance relevant to the current reasoning task.
blocks.zh: ChartEvo采用两阶段的检索机制,在不装载整个技能库的情况下选择相关的技能。 在第一阶段,Skill前题元数据用于根据图表类型,问题特征和适用性条件筛选和排序候选人. 之后只装入所选技能进行推理. 对于每个问题,系统最多回收三个技能,包括最多一个通用技能以及两个图表特定技能,综合技能-身体预算为1 600个符号。 类似程度超过0.80的近重复技能被压制,而图表或特征匹配则优先于过于笼统或不匹配的候选人。 这一机制限制了特工人员掌握的知识,同时保留了与当前推理任务相关的指导。

blocks.en: Beyond initial retrieval, ChartEvo progressively discloses Skill content according to observed execution states. Each Skill may contain general routing guidance alongside conditional instructions associated with different Tool outcomes. At the beginning of a task, the Runtime exposes only the initial routing guidance rather than all possible execution and recovery branches. As reasoning proceeds, Tool outcomes such as accepted , rejected , and argument_error trigger the disclosure of corresponding Skill branches. Instructions associated with unobserved conditions remain hidden. Consequently, a Skill can encode normal execution, error handling, and recovery guidance while exposing only the instructions relevant to the current stage of reasoning.
blocks.zh: 除了初始检索外,ChartEvo还根据观察到的执行状态逐步披露技能内容. 每种技能都可能包含与不同工具结果相关的条件性指示的一般路线指导。 在任务开始时,运行时只暴露出初始的路线指引,而不是所有可能的执行和恢复分支. 随着推理过程的展开,诸如接受、拒绝和争论等工具结果触发了相应技能分支的披露。 与未观察条件有关的指示仍然隐藏。 因此,Skill可以编码正常执行、错误处理和恢复指导,同时只披露与目前推理阶段有关的指示。

blocks.en: ChartEvo organizes executable capabilities through a two-level Tool Catalog. The overview level provides the names and concise functional descriptions of all registered Tools, allowing the Agent to discover available capabilities. The detail level selectively exposes complete interfaces for a small set of relevant Tools, including input schemas, output fields, invocation constraints, and usage examples. During initial context construction, at most six detailed Tool interfaces are disclosed; after context refresh, this limit is reduced to four. Candidate selection incorporates signals from the retrieved Skills, Tools referenced by relevant SELT, question semantics, recently invoked Tools, and Tools associated with preceding execution failures. This separation preserves broad capability discoverability while limiting the context occupied by detailed executable interfaces.
blocks.zh: ChartEvo通过一个两级工具目录组织可执行能力. 概览级别提供了所有已注册工具的名称和简洁的功能描述,使代理商能够发现现有能力. 细节级别有选择地暴露了一小组相关工具的完整界面,包括输入计划,输出字段,引用限制,以及使用实例. 在初始上下文构建期间,最多披露6个详细的工具界面;在上下文刷新后,这一限制减少到4个. 候选人选择包含从检索的技能、相关SELT参考的工具、问题语义、最近引用的工具以及与先前执行失败有关的工具。 这种分离保留了广泛的能力可发现性,同时限制了详细可执行界面所占用的上下文.

blocks.en: The set of available SELT is further restricted by the retrieved Skills and task-specific applicability conditions. The Runtime first collects SELT references from the selected Skills and then filters candidates according to chart metadata, question semantics, and parameter bindability. An eligible SELT must satisfy its chart applicability conditions, match relevant question terms, and admit the binding of required selectors from the question, legend, or axis metadata. Candidates with unresolved references, ambiguous identifiers, or unsatisfied execution prerequisites are excluded from the available SELT catalog. The remaining SELT are presented to the Agent as reusable execution structures, from which the Agent may select an appropriate composition for the current task.
blocks.zh: 这套可用的SELT受到检索技能和特定任务适用条件的进一步限制。 运行时首先从选定的技能中收集SELT的引用,然后根据图表元数据过滤候选人,提问语义,以及参数的绑定性. 符合条件的SELT必须满足其图表适用性条件,匹配相关的问题术语,并承认从问题,图例,或轴元数据中所需的选择者的约束. 有未解决的参考文献、模棱两可的识别符号或未满意的执行先决条件的候选人被排除在现有的SELT目录之外。 剩余的SELT作为可重复使用的执行结构提交给代理,代理可以从中为当前的任务选择适当的组成.

blocks.en: Together, these mechanisms enable ChartEvo to organize an expanding harness into a compact, task-relevant reasoning context. Skill knowledge, executable Tool interfaces, and reusable SELT are disclosed selectively, with subsequent guidance adapting to observed execution states.
blocks.zh: 这些机制共同使ChartEvo能够将扩大的利用组织成一个紧凑、与任务相关的推理背景。 有选择地披露技能知识、可执行工具接口和可重复使用的SELT,随后的指导则根据观察到的执行状态进行调整。

blocks.en: C.3 Harness Execution and Runtime Contracts
blocks.zh: C.3 合理执行和运行时间合同

blocks.en: Following harness retrieval and disclosure, the Agent selects individual Tools, reuses existing SELT, or dynamically composes Tool calls based on the current question, chart information, and accumulated observations. For individual Tools, the Agent constructs invocation arguments using relevant chart elements, data series, axis information, and available evidence. For SELT, the Agent determines whether the functional contract matches the current task and binds the required external parameters, while the internal execution order and parameter dependencies are predefined by the persisted composition. This separation allows the Agent to retain control over semantic decisions and capability selection while delegating predefined execution procedures to the Runtime.
blocks.zh: 在使用后进行检索和披露,代理将选择单个工具,重新使用现有的SELT,或动态编译 基于当前问题的工具调用,图表信息和累积观测. 对于单个工具,代理使用相关的图表元素,数据序列,轴线信息和可用证据构建引用参数. 对于SELT,代理确定功能合同是否与当前任务相匹配并约束所需的外部参数,而内部执行令和参数依赖则由持续构成预先定义. 这种分离使代理人能够保留对语义决定和能力选择的控制,同时将预先定义的执行程序委托给运行时间.

blocks.en: The Runtime executes the selected harness capabilities and validates their outputs against the corresponding contracts. For individual Tools, it performs the requested operations using the Agent-provided arguments and returns structured visual or numerical evidence. For SELT, the Runtime executes the constituent Tool calls sequentially according to the predefined composition, resolves parameter dependencies across steps, and aggregates the resulting observations. These internal Tool calls proceed without requiring a separate Agent decision at each step, reducing repeated MLLM–Tool interactions. Both individual Tools and SELT are subject to contract validation, including input/output interface constraints and component-specific functional requirements. Successful execution alone does not guarantee that the resulting evidence is accepted; the outputs must also satisfy the corresponding validity conditions before being used in subsequent reasoning. This contract-aware execution mechanism provides the Agent with structured evidence accompanied by explicit acceptance states.
blocks.zh: 运行时执行选定的控制能力,并根据相应的合同验证其产出。 对于个人工具,它利用代理提供的参数进行所要求的操作,并返回结构化的视觉或数字证据。 对于SELT,运行时会按照预定义的构成顺序执行组成工具调用,解决跨步骤的参数依赖性,并汇总由此产生的观测结果. 这些内部工具调用不要求每个步骤有单独的代理决定,从而减少重复的MLLM-Tool相互作用. 单个工具公司和SELT公司都需经过合同验证,包括输入/输出接口限制和特定部件的功能要求。 仅仅成功执行并不能保证由此产生的证据被接受;产出还必须满足相应的有效性条件,然后才用于后续推理. 这种了解合同的执行机制为代理人提供了结构化的证据,并附有明确的接受国。

blocks.en: After execution, the Runtime returns the resulting observations and execution states to the Agent. Outputs satisfying the applicable contracts are marked as accepted , allowing the Agent to incorporate the evidence into subsequent numerical reasoning or Tool invocations. Outputs that fail the relevant acceptance conditions are marked as rejected , while invalid invocation arguments produce states such as argument_error . Based on this feedback, the Agent may revise arguments, select alternative Tools, reorganize subsequent execution steps, or proceed with the available evidence. These execution states also inform the conditional Skill disclosure mechanism described in Section C.2 , providing additional guidance aligned with the observed execution outcomes. Through this interaction, semantic reasoning and contract-aware execution remain coordinated throughout multi-step chart reasoning.
blocks.zh: 执行后, Runtime 将所得出的观察和执行状态返回代理. 满足适用合同的产出标注为已接受,使代理人能够将证据纳入随后的数字推理或工具引用。 不符合相关接受条件的产出被标记为被拒绝 ,而无效的引用参数则产生参数-error 等状态。 基于这些反馈,代理商可以修改论证,选择替代工具,重组后续执行步骤,或者着手处理现有证据. 这些执行状态还为C.2节所述的有条件技能披露机制提供了信息,提供了与所观察到的执行结果相一致的补充指导。 通过这种互动,语义推理和合同意识执行在整个多步骤图表推理中继续协调.

blocks.en: C.4 Initial Harness Configuration
blocks.zh: C.4 初步利用配置

blocks.en: To clarify the initial capability boundary of ChartEvo, we describe the harness configuration used before self-evolution. Both ChartBench and ChartX start from the same initial harness and undergo independent self-evolution. The initial harness consists of 4 Skills and 25 generic Tools, providing foundational capabilities for chart understanding, visual evidence extraction, and numerical processing. No SELT are predefined in the initial harness. The complete inventories of initial Skills and Tools, together with their functional descriptions, are provided in Tables 8 and 9 .
blocks.zh: 为了澄清ChartEvo的初始能力边界,我们描述了在自我演化前使用的绳索配置. Chart Bench 和 ChartX 都从相同的初始带开始,并经历独立的自我演变. 最初的利用包括4个技能和25个通用工具,为图表理解、视觉证据提取和数字处理提供基础能力。 初始带中没有 SELT 预定义 。 初步技能和工具的完整清单及其功能说明见表8和9。

blocks.en: Appendix D Case Study
blocks.zh: 附录D 案例研究

blocks.en: We present qualitative analyses of ChartEvo’s inference trajectories to examine how the evolved harness supports numerical chart reasoning in practice. We organize the cases into three categories: successful reasoning, error recovery, and unsuccessful reasoning. Together, they illustrate the utilization of structured evidence, adaptation to intermediate execution feedback, and remaining limitations in challenging chart scenarios.
blocks.zh: 我们提出ChartEvo推论轨迹的定性分析, 我们把案件分为三类:成功的推理、错误的恢复和失败的推理。 它们共同说明结构化证据的利用、对中间执行反馈的适应,以及挑战性图表情景中仍然存在的局限性。

blocks.en: D.1 Successful Reasoning Cases
blocks.zh: D.1 成功的理由说明案件

blocks.en: We first examine successful reasoning trajectories to illustrate how ChartEvo utilizes its evolved harness to solve challenging numerical questions. These cases highlight the coordination of multiple executable capabilities, including target identification, visual evidence extraction, and numerical calibration, and how their intermediate observations contribute to the final prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们首先研究成功的推理轨迹,以说明ChartEvo如何利用其演化的优势来解决具有挑战性的数字问题。 这些案件突出了多种可执行能力之间的协调,包括目标识别、视觉证据提取和数值校准,以及它们的中间观测如何有助于最终预测。

blocks.en: Figure 6 presents an example involving a 3D grouped bar chart. ChartEvo identifies the target category and series, calibrates the numerical axis, and integrates geometric observations with axis anchors to estimate the target value. The resulting prediction of 7.9527 closely matches the ground truth of 7.9, illustrating the effectiveness of structured evidence integration for numerical reasoning over complex chart geometry.
blocks.zh: 图6举例说明了三维条形图。 图表 Evo识别目标类别和系列,校准数值轴,并将几何观测与轴锚结合,以估计目标值. 由此得出的7.9527的预测与7.9的地面真理非常吻合,说明了结构化的证据整合对于数字推理相对于复杂图表几何学的有效性.

blocks.en: D.2 Error Recovery Cases
blocks.zh: D.2 错误回收案例

blocks.en: We further investigate reasoning trajectories in which ChartEvo encounters intermediate execution errors but ultimately reaches correct predictions. These cases highlight how the Agent interprets Tool feedback, revises its actions, and recovers from unsuccessful intermediate steps.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步调查ChartEvo遇到中间执行错误但最终得出正确预测的推理轨迹. 这些案件凸显了特工如何解释 工具反馈,修改其行动,从不成功的中间步骤中恢复.

blocks.en: Figure 7 illustrates two forms of recovery within a single treemap reasoning trajectory. The Agent initially attempts rectangle-based segmentation, which fails due to overlapping regions. It then switches to mask-based segmentation, successfully identifying the target category and measuring its area. A subsequent attempt to measure the total area triggers an argument error because an incompatible parameter is supplied. After removing the invalid argument, the Agent obtains the total area and computes a percentage of 10.019%, closely matching the ground truth of 10%. This case demonstrates how execution feedback supports both strategy-level adaptation and parameter-level correction without requiring harness updates.
blocks.zh: 图7显示了在单一树图推理轨迹中两种形式的恢复。 代理商最初试图采用矩形分割法,由于区域重叠而失败. 然后切换为基于遮罩的分割,成功识别目标类别并测量其面积. 由于提供了不兼容的参数,随后试图测量总面积会触发一个参数错误。 删除无效参数后, Agent 获得总面积并计算百分比为 10.019%, 与 10% 的地面真理紧密匹配 。 这个案例说明了执行反馈如何支持战略层面的适应和参数层面的校正,而不需要利用更新.

blocks.en: D.3 Failure Cases
blocks.zh: D.3 失败案件

blocks.en: Finally, we examine unsuccessful reasoning trajectories to characterize the remaining limitations of ChartEvo. These cases investigate situations where the available harness capabilities or intermediate observations are insufficient for reliable numerical inference, as well as cases where the Agent fails to appropriately handle uncertain evidence.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们审查了未成功的推理轨迹,以说明ChartEvo的其余局限性。 这些案件调查的是现有利用能力或中间观察不足以进行可靠的数字推断的情况,以及代理人未能适当处理不确定证据的情况。

blocks.en: Figure 8 illustrates a failure on a 3D stacked bar chart. Although the target series and category are correctly identified, the thin target segment introduces substantial uncertainty in endpoint localization. The measurement Tool consequently returns an estimated interval rather than an accepted precise value. However, the Agent adopts the interval midpoint, producing 22.2648 million against the ground truth of 20.1 million. This case highlights a remaining limitation in reasoning with uncertain numerical evidence.
blocks.zh: 图8显示3D堆叠条形图上的故障。 虽然目标序列和类别被正确识别,但细小的目标部分在端点本地化方面带来了很大的不确定性. 测量工具因此返回一个估计间隔,而不是一个公认的精确值。 然而,代理商采用了中间点,与2 010万的地面真理相比,生产了2 226.48万。 这一案件突出说明了在推理方面仍然存在的局限性,而且数字证据不确定。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Successful reasoning on a 3D grouped bar chart. ChartEvo coordinates multiple Tool calls to extract structured evidence and accurately estimate the target value.
blocks.zh: 图6:3D组合条形图上的成功推理。 图表 Evo 坐标数 工具调用以提取结构化证据并准确估计目标值.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Error recovery on a treemap. ChartEvo switches segmentation strategies after an initial failure and corrects an invalid Tool argument, ultimately producing an accurate percentage estimate.
blocks.zh: 图7:树图上的错误恢复。 图表 Evo在初始失败后切换分割策略并纠正无效的工具参数,最终产生准确的百分比估计.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Failure case on a 3D stacked bar chart. Uncertain segment boundaries prevent precise measurement, while the Agent adopts an unreliable estimate, leading to an incorrect answer.
blocks.zh: 图 8:3D堆叠条形图上的失败案例. 不确定的片段边界阻碍精确的测量,而代理采用不可靠的估计,导致错误的答案.
